prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: a high-resolution transparent PNG image asset for the left column of the existing SURFORM website.
Input image 1 is the FINAL APPROVED composition. EDIT THIS IMAGE, do not redesign or make a new scene.
Extract ONLY the left photographic composition: the rounded-corner photograph of the graphite matte solid-surface integrated sink, with its existing chrome faucet arch protruding well ABOVE the photograph's top edge, and the existing single thin realistic continuous water stream from the spout down to the drain. Preserve exactly the approved faucet shape, photorealism, graphite material, camera angle, small water ripples, real reflections, window, greenery, jars and towel in the photograph.
Remove the entire page background and the entire right-hand text/CTA column; output genuine alpha transparency instead. Outside the rounded photo frame retain ONLY the protruding faucet and the tiny visible upper portion of the water stream. Everything INSIDE the rounded rectangular photo window stays opaque with the original interior environment. The top of the photo window passes immediately BELOW the faucet outlet tip. Keep the complete faucet arch above the frame, including the thin translucent water beginning at its outlet.
The photograph must have a straight level lower edge with cleanly rounded lower corners exactly as approved, with NO hanging extension, no floating cabinet under the frame, no extra border, no drop shadow. The photograph's left/right extents and clean lower edge should define the output's tight useful bounds, with just a little safe transparent padding on all sides and above the faucet. Approximately 1500 pixels wide, preserve aspect ratio. No text, no page canvas, no checkerboard painted into the image, no white matte or halos. Keep all the original realism and construction details.

Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the supplied transparent photo cutout of a graphite integrated sink and chrome faucet with flowing water.
Make ONE cleanup correction ONLY: clean the outside silhouette and alpha edges. Remove ALL stray red, yellow, green and white outlines, isolated colored pixels, white patches and leftover background around the faucet, top edge, side edges and rounded corners. These colored fringes are extraction errors. Use accurate clean antialiased alpha edges directly against the actual chrome silhouette and the rounded photo boundary. Keep chrome reflections inside the faucet unchanged. The open space inside the faucet's arch must be genuinely transparent with perfectly clean edges, no white/red fringe, no painted black or white background.
Preserve all the photograph's interior pixels and content, the precise existing scene, graphite sink, single water stream, drain, rounded corners, original camera angle, light and color. Keep the entire faucet arch protruding above the photo frame. Add about 20 pixels of transparent clearance above the highest faucet point so it is not clipped. Keep a level horizontal bottom boundary with clean round corners, and fully transparent clear space around the complete composition. Output high resolution genuine transparent PNG. No redesign, no text, no shadow. This will sit on pale ivory; edges must look clean on ivory.

note: Opaque photographic interior; genuine alpha outside the rounded photograph and around the protruding faucet. Preserve source family image for history. CSS crops only lateral transparent padding. No executed project attribution.
